title: About Us: AI Product Photos and Video Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: AIVideosUGC turns one product photo into store images and short video ads for a small shop. No studio, no actor booking, and uploads stay private.
h1: About AIVideosUGC: Product Visuals Made Simple
lead: AIVideosUGC turns a product photo or product page link into store images and short video ads. Add a generated presenter, voice, captions, or music, then review the file in your account before publishing.
secondary_keywords: product content tool for Etsy shops

sections.h2: Store Images and Short Video Ads
paras: Start with a photo of what you sell or a product page link. Choose a ready-made look or describe the scene, then make a square store image or a 6, 10, 15, or 30-second video.

A clothing listing can use a model photo, a coffee grinder can use a clean product scene, and a new collection can use a vertical clip for social. The video may include a presenter, a script, a spoken voice, captions, and music.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a blonde chin-length bob sets a plain ceramic mug on paper beside a closed laptop.

sections.h2: For Shopify Sellers and Small Shops
paras: A clear product photo and one sentence about the scene give a shop owner a practical starting point for a listing image or an ad. Use the same process for a Shopify, Amazon, or Etsy catalog.

Paste a product page when a listing changes, or make several versions from one reference when a campaign needs a new angle. The editor lets you adjust the words, presenter, voice, and captions before download.
sections.alt: Adult small-shop owner prepares a plain product for a listing at a packing table.

sections.h2: Private Product Content in Your Account
paras: Your uploads and generated files stay in your account and are not shown to other customers. That keeps the product references and drafts you are working on in one place.
Use photos you own or have permission to use. Requests involving a celebrity, public figure, or a brand mark you do not own can be declined.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a copper-red low bun sits by a closed laptop and a small brass padlock.

paras: Every photo and video shows its credit charge before the job starts. Starter is $24.50 per month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.
A product photo uses 24 credits. Video uses 24 credits at 6 seconds, 40 at 10, 60 at 15, or 120 at 30. A failed job returns its reserved credits automatically, and downloads have no watermark.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a short silver crop reviews plain wooden tokens beside a closed laptop.

faq.q: Can I make product ads without a studio booking?
faq.a: Yes. Start with a product photo or page link, choose the scene, and review the generated file in your account before download.
Email support@aivideosugc.com for help with an account, job, or file.

faq.q: What can I use as a starting reference?
faq.a: Use a product photo or a product page link that you are allowed to use. Add a scene description when you make the asset.
It is for online sellers and marketers who need product images and short ads from their own catalog references.

faq.q: How much do the plans cost?
faq.a: Starter is $24.50 per month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. Each job shows its credit charge before it starts.

faq.q: Can I reuse a generated presenter?
faq.a: You can select an AI actor for a video and change the presenter in the editor. The files and references you create remain in your account.

faq.q: Can a video include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. A video can include a spoken line, captions, and music, and the editor lets you change those elements before download.

faq.q: Can I publish the files on my store or social channels?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file or send it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook, then follow the rules of the channel where you publish.

faq.q: Can my software start a job through an API?
faq.a: Yes. The API lets your own software start a photo or video job. Email support@aivideosugc.com if you need access.
